purpose: Stronger silhouette distinction from approved rifleman B, independent of equipment

variants.name: A «Панцирь»
variants.description: Широкая цельная грудная броня, закрытая защита живота и массивные голени на силовом каркасе.
variants.shape: A broad, shallow one-piece sand breastplate over wide armored ribcage, overlapping compact belly plates, wide but not inflated shoulder caps, protected neck, a relatively small recessed helmet. Sand upper arm shells, armored forearms, reinforced thigh shells, broad shin guards and broad grounded boots. Clearly exposed graphite load-bearing hip-knee-ankle rails with joint actuators outside legs. Main silhouette broad rectangular upper torso tapering little to hips; upper body notably wider than slim rifleman, HUMAN not huge mecha.
variants.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE NEW second-round HUMAN heavy assault infantry BODY CONCEPT for realistic RTS, visibly and unmistakably heavier than the approved light rifleman. Reference 1 is old assault concept board: use ONLY its faction material language and sensible exoskeleton, ignore detached props and DO NOT reproduce that slim body. Reference 2 is APPROVED LIGHT RIFLEMAN: this is ONLY a contrast baseline, do NOT copy its slender chest/waist/legs. NEW design must read much broader heavier through silhouette even WITHOUT shield or firearm. Same natural adult human HEIGHT but visibly wider ribcage/shoulder silhouette, thicker protected torso and legs, exposed powered mechanical support frame. Practical engineering, not superhero, not space marine toy, no giant balloon shoulders or megabot. Palette SAME sand beige armor, graphite cloth/frame, steel, muted orange paint accents; dark unlit visor. EXACTLY ONE body fully visible FRONT symmetric A-POSE: straight arms diagonally down/out 40-45 degrees below horizontal, elbows naturally extended, open relaxed empty gloved hands with five natural fingers, legs straight hip-width feet parallel forward, torso upright no contrapposto. BODY ONLY, no rifle, no shotgun, no shield, no accessories on side, no other figures or objects. No backpack tower, horns, wings, antenna masts, blade, energy field or extra limb. Portrait full body head-to-soles and fingertips with generous margins, orthographic torso-height camera, plain warm gray studio floor/background, diffuse lighting soft shadow. Dark gaps remain at elbows/knees/waist so rigid plates can articulate. All lights OFF, no glow, smoke or VFX, no text, logos, borders or insets. Treat this as NEW unapproved proposed silhouette, not an upgrade variant. Specific body design: A broad, shallow one-piece sand breastplate over wide armored ribcage, overlapping compact belly plates, wide but not inflated shoulder caps, protected neck, a relatively small recessed helmet. Sand upper arm shells, armored forearms, reinforced thigh shells, broad shin guards and broad grounded boots. Clearly exposed graphite load-bearing hip-knee-ankle rails with joint actuators outside legs. Main silhouette broad rectangular upper torso tapering little to hips; upper body notably wider than slim rifleman, HUMAN not huge mecha.

variants.name: B «Воротник»
variants.description: Высокий броневоротник, утопленный шлем и широкие скошенные плечевые пластины.
variants.shape: A distinctive high rigid sand armored collar rising around sides and back of helmet, leaving face visible; small short helmet recessed between collar shoulders, dark narrow visor. Broad down-sloping shoulder armor makes trapezoid silhouette; wide segmented sand chest and lower torso protection, reinforced hip armor and heavy shin plates. Graphite powered support frame at shoulders, hips and knees. Practical visible joint gaps, no enormous shoulder spheres. Heavy silhouette dominated by collar/trapezoid, distinctly different from rifleman helmet atop narrow torso.

variants.name: C «Силовая рама»
variants.description: Выраженная внешняя рама от плеч до стоп; броня закреплена внутри каркаса.
variants.shape: A highly visible functional external GRAPHITE powered frame: rigid shoulder yoke, slim structural side rails down torso to hip pivots, substantial outside thigh and calf links with circular knee actuators and ankle links. Broad sand armor panels are mounted INSIDE frame, layered chest plate, elbow/forearm shields, reinforced thighs and calves, wide worklike armored boots. Clearly one human inside suit, exactly 2 arms 2 legs, mechanical frame not extra limbs. Moderate squared shoulder width and low neck surround. Recognizable engineer-built exoskeleton structure readable at RTS scale rather than a cloth soldier with bolt-on tiny details.

variants.name: D «Тяжёлые секции»
variants.description: Короткий широкий торс с крупными бронесекциями, усиленные бёдра и ступни.
variants.shape: A stocky heavy infantry silhouette built from LARGE FEW armor sections: short broad sand chest with three thick shallow horizontal overlapping bands, armored abdomen and broad hip belt, substantial sand upper arm and forearm guards, broad thigh plates and shin/ankle protection, wide boots. Compact low helmet with short graphite brow, no huge neck tower. Strong restrained graphite exoskeleton joint mechanisms connecting hip/knee/ankle, same natural human height as reference rifleman but broad body and thicker protected limbs. Avoid narrow fabric waist and slim naked-looking thighs. Clear squat broad silhouette without dwarf anatomy.
